rom_boundaries.name: BL616CL ROM API
rom_boundaries.reason: The bridge profile sets CONFIG_ROMAPI=y. libstd is built from source, but its ROM API stubs bind to the BL616CL mask-ROM ABI and cannot be replaced independently of the silicon ROM version.
